claims.text: Many reviewers find the epilator effective and are pleased with the results, often calling it the best hair removal method they've tried.
Several reviewers note that first use is painful, but the discomfort lessens with repeated use.
A recurring complaint is that the rechargeable battery wears out or stops working after extended use, and replacement batteries are hard to find.
Reviewers describe the device as well built, sturdy, and easy to hold.
Some reviewers highlight that using it in the shower is more convenient and helps with the experience.
